Install guide
iPhone · Web App

Install Web App on iPhone

Install the web version from Safari.

  1. Open binancinvest in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  4. Tap Add to finish.
Open Web App Setup
iPhone · Profile

Install iPhone Profile

Open the iPhone profile setup page and follow the install steps.

  1. Open the profile setup page.
  2. Allow the profile download if iPhone asks.
  3. Open Settings and complete the profile installation.
Open Profile Setup
Android · Web App

Install Web App on Android

Install the web version from Chrome.

  1. Open binancinvest in Chrome.
  2. Open the three-dot menu.
  3. Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
  4. Confirm the installation.
Open Web App Setup
Android · APK

Install Android APK

Download the APK and then open it to install.

  1. Tap Download APK.
  2. Open the downloaded file.
  3. If Android asks, allow installation for this file.
  4. Complete installation and open the app.
Download APK
